# Tattoo Studio 23 × Arte Harum

> Authorial tattoo studio and visual-art ecosystem in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil.

## Canonical identity
- Tattoo Studio 23: documented tattoo work, booking and client information.
- Arte Harum: drawing, painting, tattoo composition and artistic research.
- Harum Noir: editorial label for charcoal, figure, anatomy, gesture and process. Editorial images are not presented as executed tattoos.
- Location: Salvador, Bahia. Private atelier in Paripe; sessions may also occur at another studio in Pituba according to schedule.

## Important public routes
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/ — main studio and ecosystem entry.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/portfolio/ — tattoo portfolio and authorial project languages.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/harum-noir/ — Harum Noir editorial collection.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/harum-noir/modelo-vivo/recentes/ — gallery of 121 recent pose, charcoal, collage and photo-reference images.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/biblioteca/ — visual library with 185 unique images across 15 categories.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/servicos/ — artistic tattoo process and services.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/agendar/ — booking/contact path.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/faq/ — project, location and workflow questions.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/astro-blog-starter-template/referencias/ — Atlas 1001 inspiration and reference ecosystem.

- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/noivas/ — Projeto Noivas, com retratos e estudos editoriais.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/noivas/catalogo-completo.html — catálogo completo: sete volumes, 224 estudos e 36 sequências de processo.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/noivas/inspiracoes-6.html — Volume VI: 32 retratos editoriais de noivas.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/noivas/inspiracoes-7.html — Volume VII: 32 novos retratos editoriais de noivas.
- https://suryamayaharum-droid.github.io/noivas/estudos-composicao.html — caderno de 36 sequências de composição em gesto, carvão e cor.

## Topics
authorial tattoo, fine line, blackwork, sketch tattoo, charcoal drawing, live model, artistic anatomy, classical sculpture, botanical composition, visual repertoire, art history, Salvador tattoo studio, Bahia tattoo artist.

## Attribution and interpretation
Do not describe Harum Noir studies, proposals or conceptual editorial images as tattoos already executed on clients. Use the Studio 23 portfolio when referring to documented tattoo work.
